capabilities: Read EPUB files in scroll or paginated mode with remembered positions
Highlight text with colors and attach notes to highlights
Export highlights and book text to Markdown with custom templates
Import highlights from pasted Markdown quotes or JSON
Merge repeated highlight exports into one note, removing duplicates
extras: The manifest carries the warning "This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff." Annotations are stored as .json files that Obsidian's sidebar hides by default; the README explains how to make them visible.
problem: Obsidian cannot open EPUB books, so readers must use a separate app and manually move highlights into their vault.

relations.evidence: EPUB rendering is powered by epub.js.

summary: EPUB reader that opens .epub files inside Obsidian with color-coded highlights, notes, and Markdown export of annotations and book text.
